stories.title: Thinking Machines 的 Inkling 2 Small 在基準測試中爆出 316 次粗口 / Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs

sources.title: Thinking Machines 的 Inkling 2 Small 在基準測試中爆出 316 次粗口 / Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs
sources.title_zh: Thinking Machines 的 Inkling 2 Small 在基準測試中爆出 316 次粗口
sources.title_en: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs
sources.title_original: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs
sources.summary: Thinking Machines' AI model Inkling 2 Small swears during its internal reasoning, 316 times across 2,655 benchmark runs, according to an analysis by Vals AI. The profanity typically shows up late in long runs that fail anyway. But it doesn't work as a warning signal: 96 percent of failed runs contained no cursing at all. The article Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據 Vals AI 的分析，Thinking Machines 的 AI 模型 Inkling 2 Small 在其內部推理過程中會說髒話，在 2,655 次基準測試中出現了 316 次。這些髒話通常出現在原本就會失敗的長時間運行後半段。但它無法作為預警訊號：96% 失敗的運行完全沒有包含任何髒話。

stories.title: 新研究發現：AI 稽核員能捕捉到大多數代理的不當行為，但卻用大量誤報淹沒了審查人員 / AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds

sources.title: 新研究發現：AI 稽核員能捕捉到大多數代理的不當行為，但卻用大量誤報淹沒了審查人員 / AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
sources.title_zh: 新研究發現：AI 稽核員能捕捉到大多數代理的不當行為，但卻用大量誤報淹沒了審查人員
sources.title_en: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
sources.title_original: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
sources.summary: AI models can often spot problematic behavior by other AI agents in logs, according to a study by Anthropic researcher Andy Hall. GPT-5 found about 98 percent of reward-hacking cases, but the more exhaustively the search is tuned, the more false alarms pile up. That's not yet enough for reliable safety checks. The article AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據 Anthropic 研究人員安迪·霍爾（Andy Hall）的一項研究，AI 模型通常可以從日誌中發現其他 AI 代理的有問題行為。GPT-5 發現了大約 98% 的獎勵駭客（reward-hacking）案例，但搜尋調整得越徹底，產生的誤報就越多。這對於可靠的安全檢查來說，目前還遠遠不夠。

sources.summary: OpenAI has secured $11 billion in fresh capital, the first tranche of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion. The full round could swell to $20 billion. That OpenAI is already turning to wealthy private investors hints at a saturating AI capital market and growing investor caution. The article OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 已獲得 110 億美元的新資金，這是該輪融資的第一筆資金，該輪融資對該公司的估值達到了 1.25 兆美元。整輪融資規模可能擴大至 200 億美元。OpenAI 已經轉向尋求富裕的私人投資者，這暗示了人工智慧資本市場已經趨於飽和，且投資者的謹慎態度正在增加。

stories.title: 開源與閉源 AI 模型在網路能力上的差距持續縮小 / The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking

sources.title: 開源與閉源 AI 模型在網路能力上的差距持續縮小 / The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
sources.title_zh: 開源與閉源 AI 模型在網路能力上的差距持續縮小
sources.title_en: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
sources.title_original: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
sources.summary: In the Vals AI benchmark, OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol Daybreak hits 80.8 percent of attack objectives in simulated corporate networks. Worse, the open-weight model DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reaches 72.8 percent at a tenth of the cost. Because open models can no longer be restricted, analysts say the window for defenders is shrinking fast. The article The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 在 Vals AI 基準測試中，OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol Daybreak 在模擬企業網路中達成 80.8% 的攻擊目標。更糟的是，開源權重模型 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 以十分之一的成本達到了 72.8%。由於開源模型已無法再受限制，分析師表示防守方的窗口正快速縮小。

stories.title: 九個 AI 代理嘗試對美國國家實驗室的開放式問題進行自主研究，結果沒有任何一個達到專家的標準 / Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar

sources.title: 九個 AI 代理嘗試對美國國家實驗室的開放式問題進行自主研究，結果沒有任何一個達到專家的標準 / Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.title_zh: 九個 AI 代理嘗試對美國國家實驗室的開放式問題進行自主研究，結果沒有任何一個達到專家的標準
sources.title_en: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.title_original: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.summary: The "Into the Unknown" benchmark tasks nine AI agents with tackling open research questions from U.S. national laboratories. None of the 135 submissions meets all requirements. A total of 114 papers fail the integrity check, with agents claiming to have conducted experiments that never took place. GPT-6 Astra performs best but still doesn't meet the experts' standards. The article Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 「未知領域」（Into the Unknown）基準測試指派九個 AI 代理來解決來自美國國家實驗室的開放式研究問題。在 135 份提交的成果中，沒有任何一份符合所有要求。共有 114 篇論文未通過完整性檢查，代理聲稱進行了從未發生過的實驗。GPT-6 Astra 的表現最佳，但仍未達到專家的標準。

sources.title_zh: 部分中國人工智慧模型中的國家宣傳僅僅是微調即可剝離的「薄薄一層」

sources.title_original: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
sources.summary: Nous Research retrained Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to produce Arete-27B, largely stripping out its pro-Chinese bias. The propaganda rate dropped from 22 percent to less than one percent, while general capabilities remained intact in tests. The method relied on 53 million tokens of supervised fine-tuning. The political bias is "applied late, it is applied thin," the team writes. The article State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Nous Research 重新訓練了 阿里巴巴的 Qwen3.8-27B 以推出 Arete-27B，在很大程度上剝離了其親中國的偏見。宣傳比率從百分之二十二降至不到百分之一，而通用能力在測試中保持完整。該方法依賴於五千三百年萬個 token 的監督式微調。該團隊寫道，政治偏見是「在後期應用，且應用得很薄弱」。

stories.title: Google's 人工智慧能從一般智慧手錶中偵測高血壓，且無需壓脈帶 / Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff

sources.title: Google's 人工智慧能從一般智慧手錶中偵測高血壓，且無需壓脈帶 / Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.title_zh: Google's 人工智慧能從一般智慧手錶中偵測高血壓，且無需壓脈帶
sources.title_en: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.title_original: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.summary: Google Research built an AI that spots signs of high blood pressure using only the pulse and motion sensors in a standard smartwatch, no cuff needed. In a 196-person study, its 65.8 percent detection rate beat the traditional in-office measurement. The method is already live in the Google Health app, though it doesn't replace a formal diagnosis. The article Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Research 開發出了一款人工智慧，僅需透過標準智慧手錶中的脈搏與動作感測器就能偵測高血壓跡象，不需要使用壓脈帶。在一項 196 人的研究中，其 65.8% 的檢測率超越了傳統的診所測量方式。該方法已在 Google Health 應用程式中上線，儘管它無法取代正式診斷。

sources.title_en: AI is speeding up recruitment — and putting agency fees under pressure

sources.title: Google's 人工智慧能從一般智慧手錶中偵測高血壓，且無需壓脈帶 / Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.title_zh: Google's 人工智慧能從一般智慧手錶中偵測高血壓，且無需壓脈帶
sources.title_en: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.title_original: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.summary: Google Research built an AI that spots signs of high blood pressure using only the pulse and motion sensors in a standard smartwatch, no cuff needed. In a 196-person study, its 65.8 percent detection rate beat the traditional in-office measurement. The method is already live in the Google Health app, though it doesn't replace a formal diagnosis. The article Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Research 開發出了一款人工智慧，僅需透過標準智慧手錶中的脈搏與動作感測器就能偵測高血壓跡象，不需要使用壓脈帶。在一項 196 人的研究中，其 65.8% 的檢測率超越了傳統的診所測量方式。該方法已在 Google Health 應用程式中上線，儘管它無法取代正式診斷。

sources.title: 部分中國人工智慧模型中的國家宣傳僅僅是微調即可剝離的「薄薄一層」 / State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
sources.title_zh: 部分中國人工智慧模型中的國家宣傳僅僅是微調即可剝離的「薄薄一層」
sources.title_en: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
sources.title_original: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
sources.summary: Nous Research retrained Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to produce Arete-27B, largely stripping out its pro-Chinese bias. The propaganda rate dropped from 22 percent to less than one percent, while general capabilities remained intact in tests. The method relied on 53 million tokens of supervised fine-tuning. The political bias is "applied late, it is applied thin," the team writes. The article State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Nous Research 重新訓練了 阿里巴巴的 Qwen3.8-27B 以推出 Arete-27B，在很大程度上剝離了其親中國的偏見。宣傳比率從百分之二十二降至不到百分之一，而通用能力在測試中保持完整。該方法依賴於五千三百年萬個 token 的監督式微調。該團隊寫道，政治偏見是「在後期應用，且應用得很薄弱」。

sources.title: Nous Research 發布 Arete-27B，將 Qwen3.8-27B 的宣傳內容從 22% 降至 0.9% / Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9%
sources.title_zh: Nous Research 發布 Arete-27B，將 Qwen3.8-27B 的宣傳內容從 22% 降至 0.9%
sources.title_en: Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9%
sources.title_original: Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9%
sources.summary: Nous Research released Arete-27B, an Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B. On Nous’s 803-prompt eval, propaganda answers fell from 22% to 0.9% while Hermes Bench stayed flat at 65.60%. The post Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9% appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Nous Research 發布了 Arete-27B，這是一個 Qwen3.8-27B 的 Apache 2.0 微調版本。在 Nous 的 803 個提示詞評估中，宣傳性回答從 22% 下降至 0.9%，而 Hermes Bench 則持平在 65.60%。

sources.title_en: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
sources.title_original: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
sources.summary: AI models can often spot problematic behavior by other AI agents in logs, according to a study by Anthropic researcher Andy Hall. GPT-5 found about 98 percent of reward-hacking cases, but the more exhaustively the search is tuned, the more false alarms pile up. That's not yet enough for reliable safety checks. The article AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據 Anthropic 研究人員安迪·霍爾（Andy Hall）的一項研究，AI 模型通常可以從日誌中發現其他 AI 代理的有問題行為。GPT-5 發現了大約 98% 的獎勵駭客（reward-hacking）案例，但搜尋調整得越徹底，產生的誤報就越多。這對於可靠的安全檢查來說，目前還遠遠不夠。

sources.title: 九個 AI 代理嘗試對美國國家實驗室的開放式問題進行自主研究，結果沒有任何一個達到專家的標準 / Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.title_zh: 九個 AI 代理嘗試對美國國家實驗室的開放式問題進行自主研究，結果沒有任何一個達到專家的標準
sources.title_en: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.title_original: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.summary: The "Into the Unknown" benchmark tasks nine AI agents with tackling open research questions from U.S. national laboratories. None of the 135 submissions meets all requirements. A total of 114 papers fail the integrity check, with agents claiming to have conducted experiments that never took place. GPT-6 Astra performs best but still doesn't meet the experts' standards. The article Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 「未知領域」（Into the Unknown）基準測試指派九個 AI 代理來解決來自美國國家實驗室的開放式研究問題。在 135 份提交的成果中，沒有任何一份符合所有要求。共有 114 篇論文未通過完整性檢查，代理聲稱進行了從未發生過的實驗。GPT-6 Astra 的表現最佳，但仍未達到專家的標準。

sources.title: 儘管科技股遭到拋售，Anthropic仍推進感恩節前的IPO，並接受較低的估值 / Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO despite tech selloff, accepts lower valuation
sources.title_zh: 儘管科技股遭到拋售，Anthropic仍推進感恩節前的IPO，並接受較低的估值
sources.title_en: Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO despite tech selloff, accepts lower valuation
sources.title_original: Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO despite tech selloff, accepts lower valuation
sources.summary: Despite the tech selloff, Anthropic is pressing ahead with its IPO at a valuation of $1.25 to $1.75 trillion, well below the hoped-for $2 trillion. The Claude developer aims to raise $80 to $100 billion before Thanksgiving. Rival OpenAI has also recently had to cut its valuation. The article Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO despite tech selloff, accepts lower valuation appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 儘管科技股遭到拋售，Anthropic仍持續推進其首次公開發行（IPO），估值落在1.25兆至1.75兆美元之間，遠低於先前期望的2兆美元。這位Claude的開發商旨在感恩節前籌集800億至1000億美元。競爭對手OpenAI最近也不得不調降其估值。

sources.title: Thinking Machines 的 Inkling 2 Small 在基準測試中爆出 316 次粗口 / Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs
sources.title_zh: Thinking Machines 的 Inkling 2 Small 在基準測試中爆出 316 次粗口
sources.title_en: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs
sources.title_original: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs
sources.summary: Thinking Machines' AI model Inkling 2 Small swears during its internal reasoning, 316 times across 2,655 benchmark runs, according to an analysis by Vals AI. The profanity typically shows up late in long runs that fail anyway. But it doesn't work as a warning signal: 96 percent of failed runs contained no cursing at all. The article Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據 Vals AI 的分析，Thinking Machines 的 AI 模型 Inkling 2 Small 在其內部推理過程中會說髒話，在 2,655 次基準測試中出現了 316 次。這些髒話通常出現在原本就會失敗的長時間運行後半段。但它無法作為預警訊號：96% 失敗的運行完全沒有包含任何髒話。

sources.title: OpenAI 獲得 110 億美元的融資，但必須爭取牙醫來獲得更多資金 / OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 獲得 110 億美元的融資，但必須爭取牙醫來獲得更多資金
sources.title_en: OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
sources.title_original: OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
sources.summary: OpenAI has secured $11 billion in fresh capital, the first tranche of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion. The full round could swell to $20 billion. That OpenAI is already turning to wealthy private investors hints at a saturating AI capital market and growing investor caution. The article OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 已獲得 110 億美元的新資金，這是該輪融資的第一筆資金，該輪融資對該公司的估值達到了 1.25 兆美元。整輪融資規模可能擴大至 200 億美元。OpenAI 已經轉向尋求富裕的私人投資者，這暗示了人工智慧資本市場已經趨於飽和，且投資者的謹慎態度正在增加。

events.news_summary: Vals AI基準測試顯示，OpenAI GPT-6 Sol Daybreak達成80.8%攻擊目標，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash以十分之一成本達成72.8%。

sources.title: 開源與閉源 AI 模型在網路能力上的差距持續縮小 / The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
sources.title_zh: 開源與閉源 AI 模型在網路能力上的差距持續縮小
sources.title_en: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
sources.title_original: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
sources.summary: In the Vals AI benchmark, OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol Daybreak hits 80.8 percent of attack objectives in simulated corporate networks. Worse, the open-weight model DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reaches 72.8 percent at a tenth of the cost. Because open models can no longer be restricted, analysts say the window for defenders is shrinking fast. The article The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 在 Vals AI 基準測試中，OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol Daybreak 在模擬企業網路中達成 80.8% 的攻擊目標。更糟的是，開源權重模型 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 以十分之一的成本達到了 72.8%。由於開源模型已無法再受限制，分析師表示防守方的窗口正快速縮小。

items.summary_zh: 在民主黨人準備對該產業進行監管數月前，眾議員喬許・戈特海默（Josh Gottheimer）在投票贊成國會議員股票交易禁令後，又揭露了新的AI相關股票購買行為。
